title: Allium Sativum
text: This remedy is indicated in cases of digestive and respiratory disorders. It is useful in cases of dyspepsia and chronic cough. The patient is often a great meat-eater. There is a general feeling of heaviness and fullness. Confused and forgetful. Depression. Headache, with a sensation of weight in the forehead. Vertigo. Profuse salivation. Tongue pale and flabby. Garlic-like breath. Sensation of a hair in the throat. Swollen and sore. Increased appetite. Thirst. Heaviness and pressure after eating. Burning eructations. Distended with gas. Flatulence. Sharp pains in the region of the liver. Diarrhoea of thin, watery stools. Prolapse of the rectum. Violent cough, with bloody expectoration. Shortness of breath on motion. Compare: Capsicum; Arsenicum album; Senega. Third to sixth potency.
